objective: Execute approved EXP-SSI-S1 (SQIsign transcript leakage test at p=6143) and produce immutable run records.

tasks.title: Execute EXP-SSI-S1: toy SQIsign transcript leakage experiment

handoff.objective: Implement and execute EXP-SSI-S1 per the frozen contract. Produce run records for 3 replicate runs.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether toy-scale KLPT kernel scalars (mod 7) deviate from uniformity when compared to a simulator null.
constraints: Validate the frozen contract specification before implementation.
Freeze preregistration manifest (with SHA-256 hash) BEFORE any transcript generation.
Implement toy SQIsign KLPT over the quaternion algebra at p=6143.
Implement SIM-UNIFORM-KERNEL with the exact construction in the contract.
Run calibration phase (CAL-1..4) with 5000 transcripts; STOP if any calibration criterion fails.
Generate 8000 transcripts per run: 2000 real (5 keys x 400), 2000 simulator, 2000 independent-key, 2000 shuffled.
Compute chi2_7 per key, aggregate, and for all controls.
Three replicate runs with seeds: 0x20260803_EXP_SSI_S1_RUN01, RUN02, RUN03.
Record all stop-rule evaluations (STOP-1..6).
Do NOT interpret results (no hypothesis status change, no claim, no conclusion).
Record observations only: raw statistics, p-values, calibration results, timing.
If infrastructure fails (OOM, timeout, dependency error), record the failure and STOP — do not fabricate results.
All randomness derives from HMAC-SHA256(master_seed, domain_tag || counter) as specified.
deliverables: runs/run_01/ runs/run_02/ runs/run_03/ (raw results per run)
completion_gate: Preregistration manifest frozen with hash before any computation
If calibration passes: 3 replicate runs completed or stopped per stop_rules
Execution report with all raw statistics, p-values, timings, and stop-rule evaluations

handoff.objective: Commit and verify the EXP-SSI-S1 run records before independent review.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether run records are durably archived and source-bound.
constraints: Run alone; stage only declared producer paths and receipt.
completion_gate: Git verifies parent, exact paths, hashes, task ID, and reachable commit.

tasks.title: Independent validation of EXP-SSI-S1 run records

handoff.objective: Validate EXP-SSI-S1 run records: check preregistration integrity, calibration acceptance, statistical correctness, control consistency, stop-rule compliance, and run validity.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Whether the run records are valid, complete, and correctly report the experimental outcome.
constraints: Independent session; do not edit producer artifacts.
Verify preregistration manifest hash was frozen before first computation.
Verify calibration CAL-1..4 results match acceptance criteria.
Verify chi2_7 computation is correct (spot-check at least one key).
Verify controls (CTRL-NULL, CTRL-SHUFFLE, CTRL-INDEP, CTRL-DIAGNOSTIC) are consistent.
Verify stop-rules were correctly evaluated.
Check timing and resource measurements for plausibility.
Verdict: VALID, INVALID (with reason), or INCONCLUSIVE.
completion_gate: At least one chi2_7 computation spot-checked

handoff.objective: Archive execution evidence, validation, and official decision on EXP-SSI-S1 results.
handoff.uncertainty_reduced: Official Coordinator interpretation of EXP-SSI-S1 outcome (leakage detected / clean negative / inconclusive).
constraints: Only Coordinator writes ledgers.
Preserve exact claim boundaries: toy-scale only.
A clean negative does not assert security; it closes one statistic/modulus/prime combination.
A positive result requires mid-scale follow-up before any broader claim.
Record knowledge_promotion or not_warranted.
completion_gate: Evidence and decision cite exact run IDs and set exactly one next action.
